$comment: Edges from a surface www.boardsesh.com keeps into the Expo Web Program delete set.
Generated by running app/__tests__/import-graph-invariant.test.ts against main and
recording every edge it found. Each entry is one importer/target pair; the test keys
on from+to, so the line number is not stored (it drifts) but is printed on failure.
cutBy is the W-item that removes the edge when that is known, otherwise
teardown:<group>, which names the delete-set directory whose removal cuts the edge.
When a teardown PR lands, delete its entries here. Leaving a stale one fails the test.
